Maya C.: Heads-up — customer reported their per-org quota burned way faster after a model fallback + tool retry this morning. Console shows a huge delta between usage and expected tokens.
Ash K.: Interesting. Do we have an example request/trace?
Maya C.: Pasted anonymized snippet from their trace: 
```
request_id=rc-8a7f
model=gptx-24k
prefix="summarize:"
steps: tool_call -> retry -> completion
observed_tokens_reported: 842
expected_tokens: 420
```
Ash K.: Oof. Looks like the retry path is adding the prefix/prompt tokens again. Are we deduping prompt accounting on retries?
Todd P.: I think our meter increments at two points: when we accept the request (count prompt tokens) and when the completion finishes (count completion tokens). If a tool retries that re-emits the prefix as a new request blob we might double-count the prompt.
Sylvia H.: Also telemetry shows the tool-call wrapper adds its own accounting event with token counts — we ended up counting both the outer request and the inner tool call on some control flows.
Maya C.: Repro steps from the customer: 1) send chat with tool-enabled call; 2) tool times out and we auto-retry with same prefix; 3) billing shows ~2x prompt usage.
Ash K.: Could be two bugs: (A) retries re-emit a prompt-accounting event without marking it as a retry; (B) tool-call accounting treats tool-result tokens as prompt tokens for the next stage.
Todd P.: Quick mitigation: mark retry events with metadata "is_retry" and ignore prompt-token increments when present. We already have is_retry on some paths but it's not everywhere.
Sylvia H.: Agreed. We should also update the console to surface a "retry multiplier" in per-request breakdown so support can see this quickly. Right now the UI aggregates by request_id only, which hides retries.
Maya C.: Work plan: Ash to add server-side guard to skip prompt increment on is_retry, Todd to add a unit test that simulates tool timeouts reusing KV cache, Sylvia to add a temporary console column. ETA EOD?
Ash K.: I'll push a small patch: in meter/ingest we check `if (event.tags.includes('is_retry')) return;` and add comment. Will add a telemetry counter for dropped_prompt_events.
Todd P.: I'll add integration test e2e/quotas/retry_prefix.test.ts that covers three sequences (no-retry, retry-same-prefix, retry-different-prefix). Also assert per-key quota change == single prompt + completion, not prompt*2.
Sylvia H.: For console change I'll add a lightweight flag: show_retry_column=true under /admin/usage view. That reduces noise and is reversible.
quota-bot: deploy-job rc-8a7f: patch queued by Ash K. CI: 6/7 passed — failing flakiness on model-mock.
Maya C.: Good. Follow-up question: do we need a retroactive crediting job for affected orgs?
Todd P.: We'll compute delta = observed_reported - recomputed_from_trace. If delta > threshold we create a credit entry. Need finance sign-off for credits > $X.
Maya C.: I'll loop in finance if we see >5 orgs. For now prioritize fix + telemetry so we can detect.
Ash K.: Patch PR: https://git.redwood.ai/p/ingest/+/4321 — adds is_retry guard, emits metric `ingest.dropped_prompt_on_retry`.
Sylvia H.: I'll add UI quicklink to the trace view: "show raw events" so support can inspect.
Maya C.: Thanks team. Once Ash's metric is in production let's run a 24h query: sum(ingest.dropped_prompt_on_retry) by org and compare to billing spike. Ping here with results.
Todd P.: Will do. Also adding a follow-up to decide whether tool-call tokens should be attributed differently (tool output vs prompt) in the long-term billing model. That one needs product sign-off.
Ash K.: Deploying hotfix now. Will update thread when deploy completes.
quota-bot: deploy-job rc-8a7f: deployed to canary (us-west-2) at 2026-07-14T08:12:14Z
Maya C.: Fix looks good in canary traces — dropped_prompt_on_retry=197 for last 2 hours, billing spike subsiding in test org. Marking P0 -> P1.
Todd P.: Leave this open until we push console changes and run credits audit. Closing checklist in repo.
Maya C.: Thanks, closing loop once credits audit runs.
